method: Regularized Bradley-Terry categorical utilities with presentation-side bias, equal whole-programme weight, 200 programme bootstraps and leave-one-programme-out prediction. No interpolation or unobserved HRTF generation.
native_boundary: Actual fixed-zero-pose native SOFA render, explicit diffuse-field EQ, native normalization, room order 0 and late reverb disabled. No inference added to processing or head tracking.
identity: Verified SOFA/programme/native-renderer SHA256; candidate snapshots; raw native input/output hashes; exported selected SOFA and native preset with separate per-programme audition-trim setup.
admission: 2..12 unique SOFAs, at least 8 programme groups and 32 trials, both comparison orders, connected full and held-programme graphs, stable bootstrap winner/margin, held-programme prediction advantage, limited side bias; every native audition must pass full-tail RMS matching, sample-peak and distinct-output checks.
scope: 1..32 declared whole-source programmes, aggregate at most 4 million PCM samples, bounded SOFA files and session JSON. Controlled listener/playback declarations remain self-reported.
uncertainty: Bootstrap stability is heuristic, not calibrated population confidence; ties are half labels, not a separately trained tie-probability model.
data: Three generated synthetic FIR candidates and eight synthetic noise programmes with predetermined choices; no listener observations, anthropometry or individualized HRTF training/evaluation.
remaining: Controlled real listener preference and localization/externalization tests with grouped unseen material/directions
Development calibration of uncertainty/thresholds then frozen independent listener/source assessment
Actual host/headphone setup, moving-head, resource and cross-platform validation
